description:
*"Teacher, can't we do it just a little longer?"*

Yi-hyun is the youngest son of a private school foundation family and a "parachute" school nurse who got the job purely through connections. His one and only goal is to live a peaceful life as a "paycheck thief"—slacking off while collecting easy money!

However, after performing CPR on a male student who collapsed from shortness of breath, he unexpectedly gets pulled into a dizzying, deep kiss. Since that day, the troublemaker in question, Yoon-gyeol, has camped out in the infirmary, claiming his attacks only stop when he makes physical contact with the teacher.

Weakened by the kid's handsome face, Yi-hyun meant to humor him for just a few days... Yet somehow, this "treatment" keeps crossing the line...?! *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*
